cadence-monthly: On day {{day}} of every month at {{time}} ({{zone}})
delete-confirm-hint: It stops posting. Posts it already made stay. The deletion is logged.
dialog-hint: Posts as you, from your account, with the same rules as a post you write. Text only.
empty-hint: Set up a weekly showcase or a monthly check-in and it posts itself.
error-length: The title and body must fit one post (280 characters)
error-zone: Use a time zone name such as Europe/London
hint: Threads that post themselves, weekly or monthly. Up to {{max}} can be active. Only moderators see this list.
load-failed: Could not load the recurring threads.
now-confirm-hint: It is posted at once. The schedule does not change.
paused-author: Paused: the author is no longer a moderator. Save it to post as you.
paused-automod: Paused: AutoMod would have held the post
paused-community: Paused: the community is not available
paused-refused: Paused: the community rules refused the post
paused-sanctioned: Paused: the author cannot post here right now
